profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary: Seasoned Software Engineer with 18 years of professional experience. I've done everything from real-time embedded systems for the military to web applications for banks. I enjoy a good challenge and I love coming up with solutions for people.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, development, testing and support of multiple software applications and APIs.
Designed and developed cloud native .Net core applications that run in OpenShift pods. Applications are built and deployed with Bamboo from code stored in BitBucket.  ​
Designed, developed, enhanced, maintained and supported several .Net  applications running on Windows servers over the years. Implemented CI/CD for all of these applications with TFS/Azure DevOps.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a small team working on the complete system redesign of the Fire Control System (FCS). 
Responsible for the design and implementation of various components of the new Fire Control System Software. The FCS software is an embedded, real-time C++ application written with a custom operating system abstraction layer. The software can be configured to run on Windows, Linux or VxWorks with very minor modifications. Some of the FCS software functions include: launcher cage motion control, navigation data processing, weapon input/output(I/O), mission processing, ballistics management, radio network communications, user interface processing. 
Created a C++ .NET GUI for simulating a 12 missile/rocket system with fault creation and timeline interfaces. It is a multi-threaded simulator that provides all of the required I/O (for all 12 weapons) to the fire control system on the vehicle. This application contains a matrix display of all 12 missile/rocket states and modes. It provides the ability to change parameters and set faults during a mission to test the system software. 
Developed Xilinx Microblaze Embedded Processor projects for a Spartan3AN FPGA based radio mount board. Integrated C code with various VHDL Intellectual Property (IP) modules. Created general purpose I/O modules and wrote C drivers to interface to memory chips, flash chips, GPS module, LEDs and switches. Used IP modules provided by Xilinx to interface to onboard UARTS, memory devices, flash chips and Ethernet devices from a Microblaze C project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed, debugged and integrated DO-178B compliant embedded software in C++ using the Green Hills Multi IDE for the Green Hills Integrity Real Time Operating System.    
Responsible for object oriented software design and implementation of the Warnings, Cautions, and Advisories (WCA) module for a new intercommunications system used on the following aircraft: C-130J, F-15 and CH-53K.  The WCA module communicates via 1553 to maintain a dynamic priority driven playlist that sends voice warnings and tones to crew members on the aircraft.  
Designed and implemented the Built in Test (BIT) software module for the intercommunications system on the C-130J, F-15, and CH-53K.  The BIT module has the ability to test hardware such as discrete cards, audio cards, FPGA and flash.  In addition to hardware tests, the BIT module also tracks failures between the software/hardware interfaces.   
Performed integration and debugging of embedded software with the use of the Green Hills probe.  Heavily involved in the testing and integration of the audio.  Created software to generate and analyze a 1 kHz sine wave via the FPGA Audio Processing Engine for the purpose of testing audio loopbacks.
Selected as a member of a small Tiger Team to assist in troubleshooting issues on the Apache intercommunications system for Boeing.  The team successfully resolved 1394 interrupt and topology issues using the FireSpy 1394 bus analyzer.
Modified and updated the acceptance test and environmental stress screening software used to test Central Switching Units (CSU) and Headset Interface Units (HIU) for the C-130 and V-22 Intercommunications Systems.  Modifications were conducted in LabWindows CVI, Test Stand, and Visual Studio 6.0.  Updated test and certification procedures related to the software changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the full software development life cycle of the U.S. Navy's Landing Craft Air Cushion (LCAC).   
Performed embedded C/C++ Win32 API programming in Microsoft Visual Studio 6.0 for the following LCAC applications:  Universal Keyboard (UKB - flight computer), Common Data Recorder (CDR), Voyage Management System (VMS - navigation)
Experienced embedded C programming in Tornado; the LCAC Control, Alarm and Monitoring System (CAMS) running on the VxWorks real time operating system.  
Responsible for the software integration of the Amphibious Assault Direction System (AADS) with the LCAC.  AADS over-the-horizon (OTH), amphibious assault, command and control system provides situational awareness for the Amphibious Task Force (ATF). Added Performance Monitoring Fault Location and Diagnostics capabilities to the LCAC flight computer software.  This provides the crew with information from the Full Authority Digital Engine Controls (FADEC) and Sensor Interface Units (SIU).
Created a graphical, multi-threaded simulator using Microsoft Visual Studio 6.0 C++ and Winsock that simulates target, way point, system status, mission playback, and text messaging.  This tool was used for testing AADS-LCAC integration.
Interfaced with the following systems on the LCAC:  Radar Electronics Unit (EU), Embedded GPS/Inertial Navigation System (EGI/INS), Defense Advanced GPS Receiver (DAGR), Precision Lightweight GPS Receiver (PLGR), ARC210 and ARC220 Radios.
Helped define and improve processes in an effort to move toward CMMI Level 3 compliance.
Involved in the hardware technology refresh effort for the LCAC.   Selected replacement 6U Compact PCI and 6U VME components for prototype systems.   
Built Windows XP Embedded and Windows NT Embedded operating systems and custom components using Target Designer.
